title: Bracing the structure: the ring was mechanical after all
question: Does stiffening the LEGO structure change the ~10 Hz ring?
headline: Yes, decisively. Ring amplitude 1.75 deg -> 0.34 (81% down) and its frequency ROSE from 10.6 to 11.5 Hz. Adding 19 g of mass alone would lower a resonance; it rose, so stiffness grew faster than mass. That is a mechanical mode, and no controller setting ever moved it.
